tasks.short: Signal crane lowering and align assembly units to the bedplate centerline.

steps.what: Read the actual lift plan, bedplate drawing and centerline references
inputs: actual approved lift plan and bedplate drawing

steps.what: Signal the crane operator to lower assembly units and physically align the centerline
inputs: checked lift and centerline references
actual suspended assembly and site conditions

steps.what: Inspect actual final alignment and seating against the drawing
inputs: actual lowered and aligned assembly
checked lift and centerline references

steps.what: Write and approve actual lowering and alignment findings in the work order
inputs: actual alignment inspection findings
outputs: approved final actual alignment work note

steps.what: Save the approved actual alignment work note
inputs: approved final actual alignment work note

tasks.design: Retain human crane signalling, alignment and inspection. OTHER denotes lift equipment and {MAINTENANCE_SYSTEM}. The drawing lookup, actual work-note entry and its gated save are explicitly separate; under the stated existing native drawing link and direct work-order template, no further software change is identified.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task depends on actual load position and site communication.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native drawing links and work-order fields already cover the separable digital work in this scenario.
tasks.still_hard: Safe communication around a moving suspended load and precise physical alignment.
tasks.human_edge: The millwright sees actual conditions and stops an unsafe movement.
tasks.altitude: No change to the millwright work in this bounded scenario.

evidence.claim: Maintenance systems provide native work-order records; this does not establish a new saving for crane signalling.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. The worked boundary includes actual signalling, drawing lookup, inspection, written work note and save; crane operator labour is outside this focal-role denominator.

Test the existing native drawing link and asset-specific note template before declaring zero. unknowns: Whether the existing drawing link and direct note template are present

tasks.short: Troubleshoot equipment, electrical components, hydraulics and mechanical systems.

steps.what: Retrieve the actual asset fault history, drawings and diagnostic references using native work-order links
inputs: actual asset identifier and reported symptoms
actual maintenance history and approved drawings
outputs: millwright-checked fault context and diagnostic references

steps.what: Inspect and test actual equipment, electrical components, hydraulics or mechanical systems to diagnose faults
inputs: millwright-checked fault context and diagnostic references
actual isolated equipment and test instruments
outputs: actual test readings and millwright diagnosis

steps.what: Write and approve actual diagnostic evidence, unresolved faults and work-order findings
inputs: actual test readings and millwright diagnosis

steps.what: Save the approved final diagnostic work-order note
inputs: approved final diagnostic work-order note

tasks.design: Configure asset-specific history and approved diagnostic reference links in {MAINTENANCE_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER alongside physical test equipment. The millwright checks context and performs actual troubleshooting. Actual diagnosis writing and its separately gated save remain full effort; no model diagnoses or directs equipment operation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant maintenance and drawing versions may be gathered manually before fault testing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset and work-order links can reuse exact history and drawing references.
tasks.still_hard: Intermittent failures, safe isolation and interpreting actual electrical or hydraulic behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: The millwright combines measurements with physical experience of the machine.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated context retrieval before human fault diagnosis.

evidence.claim: Native maintenance records and history exist; the diagnostic reference configuration is a proposed local design.

assumptions: All shares and remaining effort are provisional. Observe residual history and drawing retrieval after existing maintenance views. Existing alarms, diagnostic functions and system runtime earn no new saving.

Actual maintenance records supply asset_id, fault_date, symptom and drawing_version. s1 retains 7.5 hours for relevance, currency and missing references. Missing linked records are retrieved manually.

s2 retains all safe isolation, actual tests and diagnosis. s3 captures actual readings and conclusions at full time. The complete final note exists before its save; changes void approval. Same-system save earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which diagnostic references still require manual retrieval after current asset links?

incremental.description: Maintain actual asset diagnostic reference links

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final diagnostic work-order note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only context retrieval changes: 15 times 50% = 7.5 less 0.5 upkeep = 7. Low halves that benefit: 3.75 less 0.5 = 3.25.

tasks.short: Install a robot and modify its program using a teach pendant.

steps.what: Retrieve current robot installation drawings and approved program versions using native asset links
inputs: actual robot and installation assignment
actual approved installation drawings and program versions
outputs: checked robot installation and program references

steps.what: Physically install the robot and verify actual mechanical and electrical connections
inputs: checked robot installation and program references
actual robot and safeguarded work area
outputs: actual installed robot and connection findings

steps.what: Modify the candidate robot program using the teach pendant and actual installation geometry
inputs: actual installed robot and connection findings
checked robot installation and program references

steps.what: Verify and approve the complete final robot program and exact target controller
inputs: complete candidate teach-pendant program
actual safeguarded test conditions
outputs: approved final robot program version and target controller

steps.what: Commit the approved final program to the approved robot controller
inputs: approved final robot program version and target controller

steps.what: Test actual robot movement under safeguarded conditions and inspect installation behaviour
inputs: actual committed robot program version
actual safeguarded test conditions

steps.what: Write and approve actual robot installation, program version and test findings
inputs: actual robot movement test findings
actual committed robot program version
outputs: approved final actual robot installation record

steps.what: Save the approved actual robot installation record
inputs: approved final actual robot installation record

tasks.design: Configure native asset links in {MAINTENANCE_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER with the robot controller and teach pendant. The millwright installs the robot, edits the actual candidate program and approves its final version before a separate controller commit and safeguarded movement test. The actual test record is then written and approved before its separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current installation drawings and program references may require repeated manual retrieval.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset links can identify the actual approved drawing and controller program version.
tasks.still_hard: Physical installation, collision risks, actual geometry and safe teach-pendant operation.
tasks.human_edge: The millwright verifies actual movement and stops unsafe behaviour.
tasks.altitude: Easier version retrieval with installation and program authority retained by the millwright.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintenance asset records can link actual drawings and controller program versions; no autonomous robot programming capability is claimed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Observe residual reference retrieval after existing asset and controller functions. Existing backups, controller runtime and same-controller commit clicks earn no new saving.
Actual engineering owner supplies asset_id, drawing_version, program_version and controller_id. s1 retains 6 hours for actual target and currency checking; missing references are verified manually.

s4 approves only the completed program for the exact controller under actual safeguarded conditions. Any edit requires renewed approval before s5. s6 retains all physical testing and any repeat correction cycle; no production release is inferred. s7 records actual findings before s8. Same-system saves earn no benefit.
